fluff.overview: The Capellan Confederation has always relied on its infantry to compensate for the CCAF's chronic shortage of heavier assets. Conventional foot soldiers, drawn from the citizens' militia system that defines Capellan military service, form the backbone of garrison forces across the Confederation's commonalities. Hover-mechanized platoons are the fastest infantry formation in the CCAF, using hovercraft transports capable of crossing water and open ground at speeds that tracked and wheeled vehicles cannot match. Their speed makes them effective scouts and flanking elements, though the hover transports themselves are fragile. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
